start: Member linked to a gym; the trainer Ravi gave Lateral Raise a YouTube link in the member's workout plan

user_sees: Card 'Watch your trainer', 'A video from Ravi on YouTube'
must_not: The card on an exercise that has no link

user_sees: YouTube (or the browser) opens the video
must_not: A link that is not an https YouTube link opened

start: Today's workout of the day from the gym has a link on an exercise the trainer typed by hand (no library key)

user_sees: Card 'Watch your trainer', 'A video from your gym on YouTube' when no name is known
must_not: No card when the names match apart from capitals and spaces
The plan's older link shown instead of today's

start: Exercise with no trainer link, or a phone that cannot open the link

steps.action: Open an exercise page with no link
user_sees: Nothing extra; the page as before
must_not: An empty card or a gap

steps.action: Tap 'Watch your trainer' when nothing can open it
user_sees: 'Couldn't open the video', 'Check your internet, then try again.'

steps.action: The trainer removes the link; the app reads the gym's plans again
user_sees: The card gone from Lateral Raise
must_not: An old link kept after the trainer removed it

steps.action: The member leaves the gym, or uses 'Erase all data'
user_sees: No 'Watch your trainer' card on any exercise
must_not: Links of the old gym still shown

start: Member who left gym A and joined gym B

steps.action: Open an exercise that gym A's trainer had filmed
must_not: Gym A's trainer name or video shown to a member of gym B
A link to a site that is not YouTube opened
